name: mcp-authority-boundary
description: A reproducible research artifact: machine-checked Cedar authorization at the MCP boundary holds even when the LLM is adversarial.

scripts.demo:live: npm run build && MCP_LIVE_MODEL=1 node dist/src/demo.js
scripts.verify: npm run build && node dist/src/demo.js && node dist/src/replay.js && node --test --test-concurrency=1 'dist/test/*.test.js' && node scripts/screenshot.mjs
